_comment: Google Apps Script web-app endpoints behind the simulator. Keep them here so a URL change never means editing HTML. Note: these URLs are visible to anyone who opens the pages, so the Apps Script itself must validate every request — never rely on the URL being secret.
_timeoutNote: Apps Script normally answers in ~3s, but a cold start after a deploy can take far longer. 30s is long enough not to fail a slow-but-working call, short enough that a genuine hang becomes visible instead of spinning for ever.
